fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Valid, publicly accessible image URL (maximum 1,000 characters). Supported formats: PNG, JPG, and JPEG; WEBP and GIF are not supported. Provide exactly one of imageUrl, imageBase64, or imageId

fields.name: imageBase64
fields.description: Raw Base64-encoded image content without a data:image/jpeg;base64, prefix. Supported formats: PNG, JPG, and JPEG.

fields.name: imageId
fields.description: 1688 image ID. Image-search results also return this value; include it when page is greater than 1 to improve response time

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Number of products per page, maximum 50

fields.name: priceStart
fields.description: Minimum price in CNY, for example 10

fields.name: priceEnd
fields.description: Maximum price in CNY, for example 100

fields.name: filter
fields.description: Comma-separated filter conditions. Use the supported filter values documented for this endpoint

fields.name: sort
fields.description: Sort condition as JSON in the form {field: direction}. Fields: price, rePurchaseRate, or monthSold. Directions: asc or desc

fields.name: keyword
fields.description: Keyword used to search within the results

fields.name: productCollectionId
fields.description: Single product-collection ID. Use a supported collection ID documented for this endpoint
